title: Nested Objects & Arrays of Objects
objective: Combine arrays and objects to model more complex, real data.

sourceAlignment.title: JavaScript Crash Course
sourceAlignment.author: Nick Morgan
sourceAlignment.note: Alignment metadata only. Lesson prose and exercises are original Code Forge material.

paragraphs: An array of objects is useful when you have many similar records — each object describes one item, and the array holds all of them. A roster of apprentices, each with a name and a rank, is naturally an array of objects.

An object can also hold a nested object as one of its values, which is handy for grouping related details under one key — for example, an order object with a nested shipping object holding the address details.
Reaching into nested data just means chaining property access: apprentices[0].name reads the first apprentice's name, and order.shipping.city reaches two levels deep into a nested object.
explanation.rule: Use an array of objects for many similar records, and a nested object when one record needs its own grouped sub-details.

examples.title: An Array of Objects
examples.note: apprentices[0] is the first object; .name reaches its property. Chaining index and property access gets you to any value in the structure.

examples.title: A Nested Object
examples.note: order.shipping is itself an object; chaining another .city reaches the value nested two levels deep.

checks.question: const crew = [{ name: "Ada" }, { name: "Bram" }]; — how do you read the second crew member's name?

feedback.correct: Correct — crew[1] gets the second object, and .name reads its property.
feedback.incorrect: First index into the array to get the object (crew[1]), then read its property (.name).

assignment.title: Squad Roster
assignment.brief: Write squadLeader(squad) that takes an array of objects (each with name and rank), and returns the name of the member with rank 1.
requirements: Loop through squad to find the object whose rank is 1.

hints: Once you find the match, return member.name immediately.
Talia has rank 1 in the sample squad, so she should be returned.
